law: You can also use Web Inspector to set breakpoints in JavaScript, interactively debug, and inspect the state of your page as you debug.
Tools like Timelines let you visualize the impact of your scripts and layout on things like performance and memory use, as well as help identify causes of long frame times.
You can also use to automate testing your webpages in Safari.
As the web evolves, it is important to continually test your webpages to ensure they behave as you expect.
